minors.what: Nit: the spec's menu tree still draws Edit as `Undo / Redo / — / Cut / Copy / Paste` and ends at Paste, but the shipped template (src/main/menu/appMenuTemplate.ts:67-80) now also carries `delete`, `selectAll`, and `pasteAndMatchStyle` on darwin. r2's fix note asked for the code change *and* the spec row; only the code landed.
minors.why: Doc/code drift in the file the repo treats as the UI source of truth. Not a contradiction — the added entries are standard Electron roles and the spec never says 'these and no others' (it already flags Save/Save As as an addition on line 51) — so this is a stale illustration, not a wrong decision.
minors.fix: Add `├─ ──────────────`, `├─ Delete`, `└─ Select All  Ctrl/⌘+A` to the Edit column, and a note that macOS additionally gets Paste and Match Style.

minors.what: Nit: win32's Edit submenu is pinned with an exact `toEqual` role array (line 32), but darwin's is only checked with two `toContain` calls for `pasteAndMatchStyle` and `selectAll`. A darwin-only regression — `delete` dropped, or the clipboard block reordered — passes.
minors.why: The macOS path is precisely the one that cannot be exercised here (no Mac, no display), so it is the path that most needs an exact assertion rather than the weaker one.

minors.what: Nit: dropping the tab roles (correct — see notes) left `aria-label="Ribbon tabs"` on a plain `<div>` with no `role`. ARIA labels on a generic container are not exposed by assistive tech, so the label is inert markup.
minors.why: Harmless today, but it reads as a working landmark label to the next author and will be copied.
minors.fix: Either drop the `aria-label`, or give the strip a real container role when M6.1 lands the ribbon framework (which is when the full tabs pattern is scheduled anyway).

minors.what: Nit: `Menu.setApplicationMenu()` replaces Electron's default menu wholesale, so besides the Edit items now restored, the default **View** (reload, toggle DevTools, zoom, fullscreen) and **Window** (minimize, zoom) menus are gone too. Concretely: Cmd+M no longer minimizes on macOS, F11 / Ctrl+Cmd+F no longer toggles fullscreen, and Ctrl+Shift+I / F12 no longer opens DevTools in the dev shell (nothing else in src/main calls `openDevTools`).
minors.why: Deliberate and spec-conformant — 00-overview.md:10 defines the menu bar as File and Edit only — and window management is still reachable from the OS window controls, so this is a note rather than a finding. Raised only because it is the last unexamined consequence of the r1/r2 default-menu class of bug, and DevTools access is a real dev-ergonomics loss.
minors.fix: No change required for M0.4. When M5.1 owns the full menu, either add `{ role: 'viewMenu' }` / `{ role: 'windowMenu' }` or register an explicit dev-only DevTools accelerator via `globalShortcut` / a `before-input-event` hook.
